steps.caption: Agency Ads & LSA manager
steps.narration: This is the Agency Ads and LSA manager. Every client account under your Google Ads MCC, in one place.

steps.caption: Client accounts
steps.narration: Client accounts lists each account: status, currency, timezone, and whether Local Services campaigns were found.

steps.caption: One client account
steps.narration: Each row also shows its Click Guard mapping and when it was last checked.

steps.caption: Tick accounts
steps.narration: Tick the accounts you want to look over.

steps.caption: Queue health audit
steps.narration: Queue health audit runs the checks in the background. It only reads; nothing in Google changes.

steps.caption: Health audit
steps.narration: Health audit lists each finding by account, with its severity and a way to fix it.

steps.caption: A finding and its fix
steps.narration: Here, fourteen search terms spent money with no conversions, and the fix is a negative keyword preview.

steps.caption: Unavailable is not a pass
steps.narration: When Google doesn't answer a check, it shows as unavailable, never as a pass.

steps.caption: One preview per account
steps.narration: Each change is built per account: IP exclusions, negative keywords, presence-only targeting.

steps.caption: Review preview
steps.narration: Choose Review preview to see exactly what would change: each campaign, how many IPs, and the limit.

steps.caption: Warnings, expiry, operations
steps.narration: Warnings are spelled out, the preview expires, and every operation is listed.

steps.caption: Nothing written yet
steps.narration: Close it, and nothing has changed in Google.

steps.caption: Confirm only after review
steps.narration: Tick that you reviewed the previews, then confirm. Each account is re-checked before anything is written.

steps.caption: Menu: Agency Ads & LSA
steps.narration: You'll find Agency Ads and LSA in the menu on the left, under Google Ads.

youtube.title: Agency Ads & LSA manager in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of the Agency Ads & LSA manager in ConstructHUB: every client account under your Google Ads MCC in one list, a read-only health audit with a fix for each finding, and protection previews you review and confirm before anything changes in Google.
